title: Portalegre OSM shortlist — source corroboration, NOT an authorization to import
limitations: Independent sources confirm the named venue type/existence but do not establish availability for all user sessions.
GPS comes from OSM; only Estádio Patalino has independently cross-checked geographic coordinates.
Exact duplicate aliases in the existing database have NOT been checked because PostgreSQL read access is unavailable.
The SQL and changelog exist only as draft files and are not included in the master Liquibase changelog.
CAOP2025 municipality correlation has not run successfully yet.
